Help hedge wizard Mabai with some chores in the Garden of Serborhin, before you all go off and try out his new magic.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Exterminate the [[Seborhin Pest|Seborhin Pests]].
* Kneel to water the garden plants. You have [6...0] more plants to water.
* Pick up all fallen leaves. [10...0] [[Plant Leaves|leaf piles]] left.
* Carry the [[Bag of Leaves|leaf bags]] up the stairs. [3...0] leaf bags left.
* See Hedge Wizard Mabai for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Trade Contract]]

=== Environmental changes ===
* Once this quest is completed, the Seborhin Pests will no longer [[spawn]] in the Garden of Seborhin.

==Walkthrough==
All the tasks here are pretty easy to perform and take place in the paved garden area in front of Mabai.

The groups of [[Seborhin Pest]]s are all located near to Mabai. To water the plants, walk over and stand by each one indicated on the map, and use the /kneel [[emote]] to water them. The leaf piles can be picked up by clicking on them like loot items.
Likewise, each of the leaf bags must be picked up and carried to the top of the stairs to the left of where Mabai is waiting: you will automatically drop each bag once it has been carried far enough to satisfy the quest.

Note that the tasks do not have to be done in order: the plants can be watered as soon as the quest is accepted from Mabai as long as you know where you need to kneel, without needing to kill the pests first (the quest log does not reflect this). The leaf piles will appear as soon as all six plants are watered, and the quest log will simultaneously display the objectives for both killing the pests and picking up the leaf piles. The leaf bags appear once all the other objectives are completed.
